limits: One seed41, one model, one L4 allocation; do not generalize across hardware/models/batch
No default dispatcher promotion, merge, Tensor Core or floating-point arithmetic change
Profiles are separately instrumented and are not adoption throughput; no Nsight occupancy/register counters measured
Cold-Adam direction gate failures from prior FP32 study are not reclassified
Peak values are PyTorch allocated/reserved, not total device process memory
Initial driver incorrectly required all three lifecycle reserved endpoints to be identical, stricter than the prespecified absence of continuing growth; its false decision is retained
Eight-cycle probe and conditional long comparisons use another L4 allocation; all runtime/test source hashes match the initial short experiment
